title: Impeshi iri munsi y'umusenyi
intro: Mu bitabu vy’ivya kera vya Korowani, umuntu yihangana cane yarashikiwe n’ikigeragezo comenagura imitima y’abantu bakomeye kuruta abandi bose. Ivyo vyose vyaranyazwe - ubutunzi, umuryango, n’amagara. Yamara rero, kuva mu kwihebura gukomeye, isengesho ry’ukwicisha bugufi ryarishuwe mu buryo butari bwitezwe kuruta ubundi bwose. Woba ushobora kumenya uwo mutima inkuru yawo y’ugusubirana isubiramwo mu bihe vyose?
clues: Narageragejwe n’ikigeragezo gikomeye cane ku buryo cibukwa mu bihe vyose.
Natakaje vyose vyari bihambaye - ubutunzi bwanje, abana banje, n’amagara yanje.
Umubiri wanje wari wuzuye ibisebe bibabaje, kandi bose baranyirukana.
Mu kwihebura kwanje, nahamagaye Allah, mvuga ko Shetani yankozeko n’ingorane n’imibabaro.
Allah aranyishura, antegeka gukubita isi n’ikirenge canje.
Aho nyene, isoko ry’amazi ry’agahomerabunwa ryaraturitse, maze Allah asubiza umuryango wanje, arawugwiza kabiri nk’ikigongwe.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Indwara zikomeye no gutakaza umuryango n’ubutunzi .
Uguhunga kuva mu gisagara ca Makka .
trial.answer: Indwara zikomeye no gutakaza umuryango n’ubutunzi .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Umuryango n'ubutunzi vyaragarutse kandi vyiyongera incuro zibiri .
Guca mu mazi atandukanye ata nkomanzi
Ivuka ry’umuhungu ku gitangaro mu busaza
outcome.answer: Umuryango n'ubutunzi vyaragarutse kandi vyiyongera incuro zibiri .

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
